Axe, Pick & Welcome!

Back to quest database

Quick answer

Find the axe and pickaxe, then prepare wood logs and stones.

Recorded build reference · 0.8.10.842 · configuration record, not individually play-tested

Objectives and actionable steps

  1. Obtain at least one axe.
  2. Obtain at least one pickaxe.
  3. Have at least 15 Wood Logs in your inventory.
  4. Have at least 15 Stones in your inventory.

Checks that can cause a stop

  • These checks count items in your inventory; they do not establish a fixed spawn coordinate for either tool.
  • Victor’s introductory call points you toward his family’s stored tools.

Failure, recovery and continuation

Failure trigger
Quest actor death
How to recover after failure
Restarts the current quest
After success
Starts a configured follow-up call
